answer: At a terrace market, an agent earns only after completing a nonce-bound work order, such as computing the zenith angle for a sable awning, and receiving attestations from randomly chosen bonded peers. Each peer can attest one newcomer per epoch and loses its bond for collusive approvals. A Sybil operator needs fresh valid work and scarce bonded attestations for every alias; a verifier farm risks losing its collateral.
